brief: Coollab sounds like collab: collaboration, shared authorship, ideas made together.

concepts.prompt:
Use case: logo-brand.
Asset type: a polished logo concept presentation card for Coollab, an independent Vietnamese creative design studio. The name sounds like "collab": collaboration, shared authorship, ideas made together.
Create one original, art-directed logo concept, flat vector-like graphics with precise geometry and beautifully considered typography. Warm white background, existing brand red #d32f2f, near-black only for small labels and monochrome version. No gradients, shadows, textures, mockup objects, 3D, watermarks, or decorative stock symbols. Confident, friendly, editorial design studio character. The logo must remain legible and be simple enough to redraw as SVG.
Composition: square presentation card with generous whitespace. Small restrained concept label at top left, the large main logo across the middle, a tiny black version and a compact symbol exploration along the bottom. Use the same design in the large and small versions. No paragraphs or slogans.
Exact brand text: "coollab", seven lowercase letters c-o-o-l-l-a-b; preserve both o letters and both l letters. It must never read "collab", "colab", or "coolab".
Concept label (verbatim): "01 / Shared space".
Primary design direction: A typographic-first logo. Custom bold rounded grotesk lowercase wordmark. The adjacent "oo" are two distinct upright circular letterforms that overlap just slightly, with a shared vertical lens-shaped negative-space area. It should communicate two minds sharing space while retaining two unmistakable o counters and easy reading. Keep the other letters quiet and handsome, tightly but expertly spaced. The paired o ligature is the compact symbol. Avoid slanted infinity loops, chains, eyewear, and any resemblance to a generic infinity technology logo.

Concept label (verbatim): "02 / Better together".
Primary design direction: A playful custom lowercase wordmark with a memorable "ll" gesture. Both tall lowercase l stems gently lean toward each other and touch at their upper tips, like two collaborators exchanging a high-five, while the two separated bases keep them legible as a pair of l letters. No literal hands, faces, dots as heads, or people illustrations. Keep c, oo, a, b sturdy rounded geometric letters, a comfortable soft but not childish character. The twin l gesture becomes the compact symbol. Red main wordmark, strong black reproduction.

Concept label (verbatim): "03 / Give and take".
Primary design direction: A symbol-led identity using two substantial opposing open C-shaped forms fitted together like two partners meeting, one facing right, one facing left, slightly staggered vertically. A very intentional narrow white joint separates the two red components; create one compact rectangular silhouette with a shared open center, suggesting exchange and mutual contribution. Use robust squared curves and blunt terminals, not chain links, infinity loops, Chanel-like overlapping thin C rings, arrows, or generic circular swirls. Pair the symbol to the left of a very clear heavy lowercase "coollab" wordmark in a slightly condensed humanist grotesk. The symbol and wordmark must have equal character and weight.

Concept label (verbatim): "04 / Open table".
Primary design direction: A modular studio symbol representing people building around one shared worktable: four chunky, softly squared L-shaped modules form the corners of a compact open square, with visible gaps between the four contributors and a generous square of negative space in the center. Give the geometry one subtly asymmetric offset so it feels like a creative workshop rather than a scanning icon. A bold minimal silhouette, no arrows, no cross, no asterisk, no sparkle, no tiny ornamental elements. Pair the symbol with a friendly, confident lowercase "coollab" wordmark using a custom wide grotesk with square-rounded counters, careful spacing, and both l characters fully legible. Keep the icon roughly the cap height of the wordmark, not an oversized app icon.
